mechanism: Carbamazepine induces CYP450 enzymes (including CYP3A4) which may increase metabolism of propylthiouracil, potentially reducing its antithyroid efficacy, while propylthiouracil carries risk of agranulocytosis that may be compounded by carbamazepine's bone marrow suppressive effects.
action: Monitor thyroid function tests (TSH, free T4) frequently and adjust propylthiouracil dosing accordingly; monitor CBC for signs of bone marrow suppression and consider baseline hematologic parameters.
